result_text:
I changed the count in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` so it leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The change is one added condition in the count subquery, `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, which matches how the per-quarter and day-of-week purchase-order reports filter.

Nothing else changed, so reps with no purchase orders in the period still show 0 and the ordering is the same. I ran the existing `*PurchaseOrder*` tests offline and they passed with no output. No test calls this method, so the change itself is not covered by a test. Nothing is committed.
